assignment_context:
Assignment Title: Student Profile Management

Assignment Question:
A university is developing a Student Profile Management System to maintain academic information in a hierarchical structure. Every student belongs to a department, and every department belongs to a university. The system should store and display information at all three levels.
Implement the system using multilevel inheritance in Java. Create a superclass named University that stores the university name. Create a subclass named Department that extends University and stores the department name. Create another subclass named Student that extends Department and stores the student name.
Use constructors to initialize all data members. The constructors must use constructor chaining with super() so that the university information is initialized first, followed by the department information, and finally the student information.
The Student class should contain a display() method that prints the university name, department name, and student name in the correct format. The program should create a Student object using the user input and display the complete student profile.
Input format
- University name
- Department name
- Student name
Output format
Display university, department, and student.
Sample input
VIT
CSE
Anu
Sample output
University: VIT
Department: CSE
Student: Anu
